title: 新中式饮品战争②：一杯酸奶45元，凭啥？| China's Drink Wars P2 🥤
description:
你会花 45 元喝一杯酸奶吗？评论区聊聊。

【新中式饮品战争·第2集】现制酸奶被网友叫做「酸奶刺客」——一杯 600 毫升，卖到 45 元。贵在哪？大杯量、堆满坚果和果酱；但也有品牌的配料表里藏着植脂末。价格两极分化：高端大店 40 元起步，平价小店十几块就能喝到。有人心甘情愿排队，有人看一眼价格就走。这杯酸奶到底值不值，留给你评判。

China's fresh-made yogurt earned the nickname 'yogurt assassin' — a 600 ml cup can hit 45 yuan. Why so pricey? Big servings loaded with nuts and fruit jam — though some brands' labels also list non-dairy creamer. Prices split hard: premium shops start at 40 yuan, value shops pour it for about 15. Some happily queue; others walk away at the price tag.

AI-assisted edit; bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Neutral market observation, not health or investment advice; prices keep shifting (many brands cut prices in 2025). Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
